items.html: And behold, the inner lights enter first in the secret of the Tzadi of Tzelem, and the surrounding ones, which are the Lamed and Mem of Tzelem, remain in the secret of surrounding lights upon those vessels of the aspect of the externality of ZA himself, from the outside — and not from the outside of Tevuna herself. Thus the inner light of the Mochin is within the external vessels of Tevuna, and the surrounding ones of the Mochin are outside the external vessels of ZA himself. And behold, the matter of the Mochin at the time of pregnancy has been clarified in their own aspect, and also the aspect of their garments, which are the external vessels of Tevuna; and the remaining two aspects of nursing and Gadlut will be clarified in their place, and see there for the completion of this discourse.
